task.title: Refactor Workspace Onboarding to Quick Start Flow
task.objective: Reduce onboarding friction by implementing a Quick Start flow (5-7 essential fields) instead of comprehensive questionnaire (7 sections, 20+ fields), while enabling progressive profiling through usage signals.

context.summary: The backend has been refactored to support flexible onboarding with most fields now optional. The system uses workspace context and learned preferences from usage signals to personalize AI generation without requiring all data upfront.

key-changes.change: Onboarding validation updated: only 5-7 fields are now required
New completion level tracking: quick_start, partial, complete
New tags management API for user-created tags
AI service now uses workspace context when workspaceId is provided
Progressive profiling via automatic signal recording

Pick 1-2 tones for your content (multi-select, max 2) 4. Select 1-5 content pillars (multi-select, max 5) 5. Which platforms will you use? (checkbox group)
